description: corr_top 32bit status word field map (frozen, V1.2 baseline). Authoritative source: status位域冻结确认书_20261015.md. Optional mapping for uart_host_tool 0x05 readback.

fields.name: params_valid
fields.description: 1 = live parameter group passes G02 range check, engine allowed to run

fields.name: frame_busy
fields.description: undistort_core frame in progress (core busy, not write-out)

notes: status is latched by param_mgr at the cmd 0x05 acceptance cycle (disp_valid pulse, no busy gating); the reply reflects acceptance-time system state, not reception-completion-time
params_valid = 0 means the live group is out of G02 range; engine stops after current frame and auto-restarts on a legal group
pub_count wraps mod 65536 (~36.4 min at 30 fps); frame completion is indicated by pub_count increments, not by busy falling edge (write-out continues after busy=0)
verified readback vectors (corr_top_tb, ModelSim 2026-10-15): 0x00040312 active (I4) / 0x00070012 stopped (I6); U4 mock frames: AA 55 05 04 12 03 04 00 19 / AA 55 05 04 12 00 07 00 19
